blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Cloudy skies with occasional isolated rains are expected to prevail over some parts of the country during Undas (November 1 – All Saints’ Day and November 2 – All Souls’ Day). These conditions are due to the northeast monsoon, or ‘amihan,’ and two other weather systems, the state weather bureau said. The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) issued a special weather outlook for Undas. It said that the northeast monsoon, the intertropical convergence zone (ITCZ) and shear line will prevail from Friday, October 30 to Monday, November 2.
